operator_level_dedup: Nyctophilia's Hamburg shop and nyctophilia-shop.de are one OHG legal operator and count once.
reason: Independent PASS2 confirms a current Hamburg professional gothic-fashion operator whose physical shop explicitly sells second-hand and commission goods. First-party legal notice identifies Nyctophilia OHG, management, Hamburg HRA 124917 and VAT DE815835403. The FAQ confirms EU ecommerce shipping and separately confirms second-hand and commission goods sold in the physical shop. The current review did not materialize item-level second-hand apparel in the online catalogue, so generic EU shipping cannot be attributed to the second-hand inventory. The operator is therefore VERIFIED_HOLD, not ELIGIBLE.

evidence.finding: Nyctophilia OHG, Landwehr 5 Hamburg, management Elisabeth Unger and Christin Leibing, VAT DE815835403, Amtsgericht Hamburg HRA 124917.
FAQ states EU shipping for online orders and explicitly states that second-hand and commission goods are sold in the Hamburg shop; those shop-bought used goods are excluded from exchange.
